versions.content: If an indicator is activated in multiple modes at the same time, the API Dem_GetIndicatorStatus shall return the status considering the following priority: • DEM_INDICATOR_BLINK_CONT (highest priority) • DEM_INDICATOR_BLINKING • DEM_INDICATOR_FAST_FLASH • DEM_INDICATOR_SLOW_FLASH • DEM_INDICATOR_CONTINUOUS • DEM_INDICATOR_SHORT 143 of 536 Document ID 19: AUTOSAR_SWS_DiagnosticEventManager Specification of Diagnostic Event Manager AUTOSAR CP R21-11 • DEM_INDICATOR_ON_DEMAND • DEM_INDICATOR_OFF (lowest priority)
